claims.label: PROVED_AT_STATED_SCOPE
claims.statement: For arbitrary Boolean g,h on the same variables and a fresh d-bit one-word selector with p=2^-d, U(F) equals the exact three-term formula in BENT_OVERLAP_PAYMENT.tex involving coherent coefficients c_T, mixed caps (1-p)A_T+pB_T, difference caps D_T, and the explicit control term (pd/2-p^2d)sum_T d_T^2.
claims.quantifiers: All finite dimensions n, all genuine Boolean g,h, every integer d>=1, with zero-mass terms omitted.
claims.limitations: Identity only; it supplies no universal bound on the overlap term.

claims.label: PROVED_AT_STATED_SCOPE
claims.statement: For every even k>=8, every bent Boolean g on k bits, every one-point flip h of g, and every d>=1, the fresh one-word selector F satisfies U(F)-(1-p)U(g)-pU(h)<=71 I_ctl(F), p=2^-d.
hypotheses: g is bent, hence every Fourier coefficient has magnitude 2^(-k/2)
h differs from g at exactly one physical input
selector controls are fresh and used once
k is even and at least 8
limitations: Does not cover two or more coherent surgeries in a hierarchy.
Does not cover arbitrary shared-variable children.
Does not prove U<=KI or full FEI.

claims.label: NUMERICAL_CORROBORATION
claims.statement: The exact formula and theorem controls passed 345464 deterministic assertions, including 24 direct Walsh comparisons, 48 theorem cases, 1312 small Boolean controls, and structured majority, point-defect, addressing, and near-tensor tests.
claims.scope: Finite corroboration only; the all-parameter theorem is analytic.

claims.label: OPEN
claims.statement: No complete universal proof or genuine Boolean counterfamily with unbounded H/I is established.
